tasks.title: Fix codebase-memory MCP install datum
tasks.description: Codex startup fails: codebase-memory command /home/brianh/.b00t/vendor/codebase-memory-mcp-b00t-ir0n-ledg3rr/build/c/codebase-memory-mcp is missing. b00t install codebase-memory resolves the datum but has no install command and skips it. b00t mcp registry get/install-deps codebase-memory does not find a registry server. Add a b00t-native install path that builds or installs codebase-memory-mcp and updates the datum.
acceptance_criteria: b00t install codebase-memory installs or builds the binary
b00t mcp output codebase-memory --json points to an existing executable
Codex can start codebase-memory without os error 2
